race.description: Become A Redcliffe Hrc Member Mdn Pace
race.comment: FAN THE FLAME (1) hasn't been too far off the placings in recent outings at Albion Park. Runner-up both times she has raced here so is better placed and should get every chance from the ace draw. MATT DAN (5) produced a solid effort to come from the back row and finish fourth last time out at this circuit and distance. Placed the only time he started on the front line. Leading hope. FORGETTABLE (7) draws to trail the top pick and must be considered after he finished runner-up at this circuit and distance a week ago. GOLDCLASS (2) is a daughter of Bettors Wish on debut for the Shane Graham yard on debut. Has won a trial here and draws well so keep safe.
